author: Hildebrand, 1943

note.en: A small schooling anchovy of nearshore waters, known from Bocas del Toro (2016) but with no specimen found inside the region.
note.es: Una anchoa pequeña de cardumen de aguas cercanas a la costa, conocida de Bocas del Toro (2016) pero sin espécimen hallado dentro de la región.

evidence: GBIF: one 2016 specimen at the STRI dock, Bocas del Toro
FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the western Caribbean
